title: Bond Given To A Court By A Person Interested For Safe Custody Of Movable Properties Attached
description: A bond given to a court by a person interested for safe custody of movable properties attached used for bonds, guarantees, suretyships, or indemnity documents. Suitable for parties entering into bond agreements, sureties, or financial guarantors. Key details required: Address (First Party), Address (Second Party), Amount (Rs.), Details (First Party), Details (Second Party).
description_hi: Bond Given To A Court By A Person Interested For Safe Custody Of Movable Properties Attached — बांड, गारंटी, जमानत, या क्षतिपूर्ति दस्तावेज के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। बांड समझौतों में प्रवेश करने वाले पक्ष, ज़मानतदार, या वित्तीय गारंटर के लिए उपयुक्त। 6 आवश्यक और 2 वैकल्पिक विवरण भरने होंगे।
